windows.text: Benjamin Brown (Digestive Health Solution) is the only source for this phase. If even the "Nuclear Option" failed, you can cross the microbiome off the list.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: The problem is likely an organ that isn't working right, or environmental toxicity or your brain's false danger signals (those two are Phase 6, below).

windows.label: Human
windows.text: So check your organs. Do your stools look oily or greasy?

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: Then it's often your pancreas not making enough digestive enzymes, which doctors call Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: A Stool Elastase test will tell you, and if that's it, you take high-dose enzymes with every meal.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: If it's diarrhea that keeps coming back instead, Brown says the issue can be Bile Acid Diarrhea, where too much of your bile reaches your colon.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: He has you tested for that with SeHCAT, and bile binders soak up the extra bile.
